text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello-san! How can we turn 30 minutes into 
60 minutes!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, start from the beginning, 
please. ...The truth is, she's planning to 
hold a solo fan meeting soon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We managed to secure the venue and time 
slot, but... she says she wants to sing 
ten songs in thirty minutes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That look on your face... I suppose even 
from a professional's perspective, it's 
reckless. As a desperate measure, we have 
no choice but to cut into the talk and 
break times...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
......By the way, regarding that fan 
meeting... Is there a producer or a 
corporate sponsor backing it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nope, Falco and the others made it from 
scratch!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, how about we string 
together the choruses to make a medley 
track?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's arrange the production staff for the 
audio immediately. Also, if time is going 
to be tight, we should look into the flow 
of audience entry too...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Ah... I'm so sorry! I just kept 
rambling on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*. And so, with proposals such as 
that... Could you lend me your ear for 
just a bit longer?"
